artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with a Doric Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon in the distance, showing trees, hills, and mountains. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, with a primarily sepia color palette. A group of figures in classical attire are near a large tree, with a serene body of water reflecting the scene. In the middle distance, a cliff holds a temple-like structure above waterfalls, under an unobstructed sky.

artworks.title: A Crucifix in a Church with Saints Thomas Aquinas, Mary Magdalene, Albertus Magnus, and Others
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 21.2 x 27.1 cm (8 3/8 x 10 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in an architectural setting. The composition shows a group surrounding a large crucifix within an interior featuring tall columns and an arched ceiling. Divided into distinct sections, the space includes decorative elements and drapery. Each figure wears a long robe. A table with an open book stands in the background, visible through beams of light. The drawing uses line work to convey depth and detail, reflecting attention to proportion and perspective.

artworks.title: God Breathing Life into Adam
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure animating another figure in a natural outdoor setting. The first figure is depicted floating above the ground with outstretched arms and legs, while the seated figure below looks up in awe. The scene includes a sheep grazing and a rabbit in motion, framed by trees. The drawing conveys a sense of fluid movement and connection between the earthly and the divine.

artworks.title: Cartouche Moderne with a Young Couple Being Served Wine
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] with drawing in pen and black ink and gray wash, on laid paper incised with grounding in red chalk for transfer on verso
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 15.5 x 26.5 cm (6 1/8 x 10 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an outdoor setting. The central figure is a man in period clothing, including a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, holding a pint glass. The figure on the left pours liquid into the glass. The figure on the right is a woman holding a walking stick. The background features decorative foliage and scrollwork. The artwork is monochrome with fine lines and textures.

artworks.title: Cartouche Moderne with Emblems of Death
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] with drawing in pen and black ink and gray wash, on laid paper incised with grounding in red chalk for transfer on verso
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 16.5 x 25.9 cm (6 1/2 x 10 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of decorative architectural elements and motifs. The composition features ornate, empty cartouches on both sides, a detailed depiction of an obelisk adorned with a cameo relief surrounded by foliage and baroque-style embellishments. A cherubic figure sits near objects like musical instruments and art tools. The drawing emphasizes the elaborate design of each element with intricate lines and shadows.

artworks.title: Cartouches Modernes orné avec des [diferentes Figures] (Plate VI-1 from the set)
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] with drawing in pen and black ink and gray wash, on laid paper incised with grounding in red chalk for transfer on verso
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 14.8 x 26.7 cm (5 13/16 x 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate central emblem surrounded by figures amid foliage. The central focus is a large decorative emblem, with intricate scrollwork and foliage around it. To the left, a figure holds a long cylindrical object amidst detailed greenery. On the right, two figures in elegant attire stand near a classical architectural structure. The background includes trees and architectural elements, with a cherubic figure sitting atop the emblem.

artworks.title: Cartouches Modernes avec des Enfans qui representant les Modes d'Augsbourg
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] with drawing in pen and black ink and gray wash, on laid paper incised with grounding in red chalk for transfer on verso
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within plate): 17.2 x 26.8 cm (6 3/4 x 10 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and decorative scene featuring intricate scrollwork and floral motifs. The composition showcases intricate scrolls and foliage framing two separate vignettes. On the left, an elegantly dressed couple is depicted within a sumptuous, draped frame. On the right, two children appear to play or share a moment together, encapsulated within ornate foliage and scrollwork. Each scene is interconnected through swirling, elaborate design around a central cartouche featuring decorative text.

artworks.title: Hartford Newsboys
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Joshua P. Smith Collection, Gift in honor of Sarah Greenough

artworks.title: Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: black chalk and stumping, heightened with white gouache on wove paper, wrapped around a drawing block prepared by Niodot fils
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Morton Morris
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man from the waist up. He faces slightly to the right with a serious expression, distinctive facial features, white curly hair swept back, and is wearing a dark coat over a layered ensemble including a high-collared shirt, waistcoat, and scarf. He holds a dark folder tied with a ribbon in his hands. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Elegantly Dressed Soldier Tamping His Caliver
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a side profile facing left. The individual is leaning slightly forward with one leg in front of the other. The right arm is extended ahead, holding a staff. The person has detailed facial features, curly hair covered with a metal helmet, and is dressed in historical military attire with a musket slung across the back. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Colonnade et Jardins du Palais de Medici (Colonnade and Gardens of the Palazzo Medici)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a towering architectural facade with statues and figures engaged in artistic activities. The sky is depicted with blue and gray clouds, while trees in the distance provide a contrast to the stone textures of the building.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures interacting in an architectural setting. The composition is crowded and chaotic, with figures in various poses. The exaggerated postures and expressions of the figures create a sense of intensity. The drawing uses a monochrome palette of detailed lines and shading to create depth and texture. The lines are dynamic, enhancing the emotions in the composition. The visual style is reminiscent of mannerist art, known for elongated proportions and vivid expressions.

artworks.title: Water Dock and Brambles at a Sluice
artworks.medium: etching [proof] on chine on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Fine and Larry Day in memory of Frances Smyth
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed close-up view of a rustic scene with dense vegetation and a fallen tree. The point of view is slightly elevated, showcasing intricate textures and details of the plants and tree trunk. The composition focuses on the plant life and an old water pump or gate apparatus. The brushstrokes are precise and illustrative, resembling an engraving or etching. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia and black. The scene features fine lines and shading to create a rich texture.

artworks.title: Waterside Village
artworks.medium: drypoint with roulette and monoprint inking on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The artwork features a low angle perspective, showing reflections at the bottom. Silhouettes of windmills and buildings are seen against the sky with smooth, horizontal brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic using sepia tones. The sky has subtle variations in tone, creating depth in the background.

artworks.title: Les Échasses
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image shows two children outdoors. One child, a girl, stands upright while appearing to support the other child, a boy, who is balanced on stilts. The girl has long, wavy hair with a headband, and wears a long dress with long sleeves and a blue sash. She is holding one of the boy’s hands. The boy has short, curly hair and wears a red coat over a white outfit with knickerbockers, knee-high socks, and shoes. He is on wooden stilts. In the background, there are trees on the left and lush shrubbery with potted roses on the right.

artworks.title: Galo-Bayeux
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image shows a round apple with pinkish-red and yellow skin, with brown spots. A cut section of the apple with seeds is also shown. Leaves in shades of green, some with a bluish tint, accompany the apple. The intact apple is on a twig with leaves, while the sliced portion, displaying the cross-section, is placed at the lower left.

artworks.title: The Sportsmen Resting
artworks.medium: stipple etching in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 19.2 x 16.5 cm (7 9/16 x 6 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a domestic setting. One man is seated on the left, leaning on a cane, with a dog looking up at him. Beside him stands another man, who leans slightly towards a seated woman. The woman is relaxed in an armchair, holding a small cup in her hand. The standing man extends his hand towards her. The background features a tall bookshelf filled with arranged books, and a framed painting is visible on the wall above the woman.

artworks.title: The Sportsmen's Departure
artworks.medium: stipple etching in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 18.9 x 16 cm (7 7/16 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in the foreground wearing a jacket, breeches, boots, a hat, and a cravat. He holds a stick, with two dogs by his feet. In the background, a man and a woman stand in a building doorway. The woman wears a dress and hat with a ribbon, leaning towards the man in formal attire. The backdrop includes foliage, hills, and trees.

artworks.title: Mrs. Bonham
artworks.artist: M.G. Fuchs after Sir Edward Coley Burne-Jones
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body, seated and turned to her left in profile. She has detailed facial features, neatly styled hair, and is dressed in a dark, high-collared garment with lace cuffs. Her hands are interlocked in her lap. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Levite of Ephraim and His Dead Wife
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude figure lying on a flat surface, with another clothed person leaning forward above them in a contemplative posture. The background is dark, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Sacrifice to Love
artworks.medium: gray and black wash over graphite on laid paper, with framing line in dark brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a scene with nature, a statue, and ancient architecture. The drawing depicts a detailed and dynamic scene set in what appears to be a garden or wooded area with architectural elements. 

The central focus is a plinth with a statue of a small, winged figure holding a bow and arrow. Below, a draped figure appears startled or contemplative. To the right, there are glimpses of architectural structures suggesting an outdoor setting. The foliage is dense, with large trees framing the background. Ink and wash techniques are used to create light and shadow for a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: A View of Rome from Santa Maria del Priorato
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and gray wash with red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position with a large architectural entrance on the right. The horizon is in the middle with a prominent dome, likely St. Peter's Basilica, framed by buildings and trees. The drawing is in pen with fine strokes outlining architecture, foliage, and figures. The color palette is subdued, with beige tones contrasting with dark ink lines. In the background, there are buildings and foliage, creating depth and perspective, with light sketching lines suggesting celestial figures.

artworks.title: Figures from the Farnese Palace and from Life
artworks.artist: Gaspar van Wittel after Annibale Carracci
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and red chalk with traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of different human figures on textured paper. In the foreground, there is a sketch of a seated or crouching person from behind, with curly hair and looking over the shoulder. Below, there is a sketch of a nude man standing. To the left, there is a bust sketch of an elderly face with expressive features and hair. Above, there are faint small sketches of people in different poses. The background is the textured paper. The composition seems informal, indicating a page of practice sketches.

artworks.title: The Gardens of the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden scene from a slightly elevated angle. The composition includes clusters of trees and statues with intricate details, hedges, and architectural elements that give a sense of depth. The overall palette is monochromatic, with soft pencil and ink lines on paper.
